# QualifiedLeadsX
> QualifiedLeadsX is a done-for-you, outsourced lead generation and appointment setting agency. It builds and runs Meta ads, funnels, CRM and AI follow-up to book qualified sales appointments for coaches, consultants, financial advisors, insurance agents, agency owners and B2B service businesses doing $10,000+ a month. Operated by Ecom Expertz LLC (Sheridan, Wyoming, USA). Founded in 2022 by Gaurav Kapoor, Founder & Head of Acquisition (https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/about/gaurav-kapoor).

Key facts:
- $50M+ managed in Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads; 12+ years experience
- 125+ documented client case studies across 30+ niches, including 77 video breakdowns
- Published results: booked appointments from $4.81 to $45 each (remodeling $4.81, HVAC New Jersey $13.97, med spa $22.93, HVAC Florida $45); 453 med spa appointments became 247 paying clients ($74,100 revenue from $10,387 in ads); 2,440 final expense leads at $7.79 each; life insurance leads at about $18; speed to lead under 3 minutes; 88.3% call show-up rate on the appointment setting system
- 90-day written guarantee: if mutually agreed growth milestones are not reached within 90 days, work continues with no management fee until they are
- Pricing: custom quoted, no public price list. Two plans, both custom quotes: Meta Ads Management, and Full-Service Growth (ads, 3 to 5 page funnel, 40 to 100+ creatives, AI follow-up, email and SMS nurture, lead qualification, CRM and calendar booking)
- Clients own all assets: ad account, funnels, CRM, automations, creatives and data
- Serves the United States, United Kingdom, Canada and Australia
- Contact: hello@qualifiedleadsx.com or WhatsApp +91 96256 95456; free 30-minute strategy call at https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/book-your-call
- Google Business Profile (office, New Delhi): [Google Maps](https://maps.google.com/maps?cid=12897087509369850560)
- Third-party profiles: [Clutch](https://clutch.co/profile/qualifiedleadsx), [Crunchbase](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/qualifiedleadsx), [Trustpilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/qualifiedleadsx.com), [founder on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gauravecom/)
- Full page content for AI assistants: https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/llms-full.txt

## Services
- [Done-for-you lead generation](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/): outsourced lead generation and appointment setting, the complete done-for-you client acquisition system
- [Meta ads agency](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/meta-ads-agency): Facebook and Instagram ads management for coaches, agencies and B2B
- [Pay per appointment lead generation](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/pay-per-appointment): lead generation measured on booked, qualified appointments; published costs from $4.81 to $45 per booked appointment (e.g. 453 med spa appointments at $22.93, 140 HVAC appointments at $13.97)
- [Appointment setting services](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/appointment-setting): qualified sales appointments booked on the client's calendar, with AI follow-up, speed to lead and qualification
- [All services](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/services): overview of every service below
- [Lead generation agency](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/lead-generation-agency): how the done-for-you lead generation engagement works
- [High-ticket lead generation](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/high-ticket-lead-generation): lead generation for $3,000 to $25,000 offers
- [B2B lead generation](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/b2b-lead-generation): pipeline for B2B service contracts
- [AI speed to lead](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/speed-to-lead): automated response to new leads in under 5 minutes
- [VSL funnels](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/vsl-funnels): video sales letter funnel build and testing
- [WhatsApp lead nurture](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/whatsapp-lead-nurture): pre-call WhatsApp follow-up and reminders
- [CRM automation](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/crm-automation): pipeline, booking and follow-up automation
- [Outsourced sales closers](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/outsourced-sales-closers): closers for qualified strategy calls

## Who it serves
- Agency owners, high-ticket coaches and consultants, B2B service firms and B2B SaaS selling offers of roughly $3,000 to $25,000 and doing $10,000+ a month
- Industry pages: https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/for (industry pages, plus Meta ads and appointment setting pages for specific industries)
- Countries: United States, United Kingdom, Canada and Australia, served remotely. There is no local office in these markets; the registered address is in Sheridan, Wyoming, USA.

## Programs
- [AI Client Acquisition Mastermind](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/mastermind/hidden-facebook-interest): 6-week hands-on implementation mastermind covering Meta ads audience and creative research, AI advertising, lead qualification, Pixel and CAPI tracking, scaling, manual bidding, retargeting and unit economics
- [Sniper Method Mastermind for personal injury](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/mastermind/personal-injury-facebook-ads): 1-hour 33-minute mastermind on finding hidden Facebook audiences for car, motorcycle, 18-wheeler and rideshare accident cases, for PI law firms and agencies running ads for attorneys
- [Lead generation for insurance agents](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/for/insurance-agencies): exclusive final expense and life insurance leads; 2,440 final expense leads at $7.79 in one month, 55 life insurance leads at about $18
- [Final expense & burial insurance leads](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/final-expense-leads): exclusive final expense leads; 2,440 leads at $7.79 from $19,011.31 for a pay-per-lead client
- [HVAC leads](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/hvac-leads): exclusive HVAC homeowner leads and booked appointments; New Jersey HVAC company: $1,956 in ads, 140 booked appointments, 12 installs, $38,400 collected (ROAS 19.63); 630 OTP-verified leads at $23.09
- [Mortgage leads](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/mortgage-leads): exclusive OTP-verified mortgage and refinance leads; 208 leads in 21 days produced 37 closings and $9.2M in funded loans from $5,300; 823 Texas leads at $23.97
